requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 800.000000 mm vs spec 800.000 (diff -1.22e-10); volume 958092.902 mm3 (cap adds 94045.145; OCCT default integration gives 958104.492)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 7.11e-07 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 2.68e-03 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 1.13e-11 mm, angle 1.25e-07 deg; curvature mismatch 2.212e-06 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 1.052e-17 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 0.00022 mm, 36 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 40 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.0540398 mm at x/c 0.999812 (6 of 26 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.142 at x/c 0.99988186, t 0.7 mm (14 of 14 below 0.9); 20 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 0 on 0 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.7555 mm at x/c 0.9 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 18.73 at x/c 0.99988186 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.742945 mm at x/c 0.927727, t 6.248 mm, margin 0.3429 mm; tightest 0.356089 mm at x/c 1; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 0.013 mm; worst there 422 mm, score 4.42e+06)
